briefing.headline: xAI and OpenAI push frontier model releases as compute constraints tighten globally

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with multiple frontier labs targeting 2027 AGI milestones. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows in the US and EU. Multi-agent systems are emerging as the dominant deployment pattern.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: xAI released Grok-3 with 2.1T parameters; OpenAI deployed o4-preview internally. Anthropic's Claude 4 and Google's Gemini 3.0 are in late testing. DeepSeek-V4 matches GPT-4o performance at 40% lower inference cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA shipped 1.2M H200 GPUs this quarter; Microsoft and Google announced new 100k-GPU clusters. TSMC reports AI chip demand exceeding supply through 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory harmonization slow the US-China AI gap or accelerate covert capability races?
